mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.1% indicates an exceptionally accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the cost of capital and supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.1% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tightening labor market that increases consumer spending power and corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST > 1500) and industrial production (INDPRO > 100) indicates a synchronized expansion in the real economy, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1500 and INDPRO > 100 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, retail sales (RSAFS) above $630 billion signals strong consumer demand that sustains corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances during late-cycle expansion when RSAFS > 630 billion (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, triggering recession fears and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 thousand units indicate robust residential construction, a leading indicator of economic growth that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1500 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.1%) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals dual monetary and labor market stimulus, reducing risk premia and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.1% and UNRATE < 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market tightening regime, payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth above 150,000 thousand units signals strong job creation that boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances during labor market tightening when PAYEMS > 150,000 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).
